dct_title_s: King County, Washington : transit free ride area
dct_description_sm: Abstract: King County, Washington Metro Transit Ride Free Area as defined by streets. Covers a portion of Seattle Central Business District.

Purpose: Used by Trip Planning to define Ride Free Area stops; which determine the fare calculation in the Automated Trip Planning system. Also assists in defining where bicycles may be loaded or unloaded on the bus.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational non-commercial use only. This data may not be redistributed by HGL users. King County data are made available with the understanding that they shall be used exclusively by the obtainer or his/her authorized agents.
Access constraints: Access is granted to Harvard University Affiliates only. Affiliates are limited to current faculty, staff and students.
